## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2013-02-14: S-1/A Amendment No. 3 first attaches the form-of TRA (Exchanges) as Exhibit 10.5
- 2013-03-12: Exchanges TRA executed alongside the Partnership Agreement effectiveness
- 2013-05-09: First post-IPO 10-Q files the executed Exchanges TRA as Exhibit 10.5

#### Material follow-on offerings

- 2013-11-01: November 2013 follow-on offering triggers approximately $90M incremental TRA liability

#### LIBOR replacement amendment

- 2023-08-17: First Amendment replaces the LIBOR definition with a Replacement Rate mechanism; refiled in the FY2023 10-K (2024-02-22)

## Explanation

The Exchanges TRA was executed on March 12, 2013 alongside APAM's Up-C IPO and obligates APAM to pay 85% of cash tax savings to each Artisan Partners Holdings LP Limited Partner from Section 754 basis step-ups (including the 2006 recapitalization basis) arising on exchanges of LP Units for Class A common stock, plus imputed-interest deductions. The 2013 follow-on offering added roughly $90M in incremental TRA liability through additional basis step-ups. The August 17, 2023 First Amendment was a LIBOR-to-Replacement-Rate housekeeping update with no economic change. The contract remains in force alongside the parallel Merger TRA, with annual payments running roughly $33M-$37M. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
